items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: The president died, and then they hired Brown's band, Elaine's band. I know one time we, Elaine, he gets a, he gets a, a deal, he's gonna play at the Dolphine Theater.

ctx.x: Well, they still have those, the colored organizations like the colored Elks and different ones still put those on, but no white funerals like that. Was that for a certain club that you, an organization that would do that when somebody died? Yeah.

As a rule they didn't. Yeah. But once in a while some of us ate something. The president died, and then they hired Brown's band, Elaine's band. I know one time we, Elaine, he gets a, he gets a, a deal, he's gonna play at the Dolphine Theater. Yeah. Big motion picture comes out, you see. Mm-hmm. I think it was, uh, the life of Christ, or some holy picture, you know.
